newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CNA Gallo says assessing restructuring.
newsitem.headline: CNA Gallo says assessing restructuring.

text.p: Leading South African retailer CNA Gallo Ltd said on Tuesday that a merchant bank was currently assessing a restructuring of the group.
This CNA hoped would enable it to more effectively capitalise on growth opportunities for its burgeoning entertainment businesses.
The company urged shareholders to continue to exercise caution in their dealings but gave no further details.
A previous cautionary announcement on the considered restructuring was issued on May 12.
